editor.mcrh.pixelEditor.name: MCRH Pixel Brush
language.setting: Display language for MCRH panels and messages. Reload the window to apply changes.
manifest.description: Minecraft resource pack tools for textures, PBR maps, models, GUI previews and pack diagnostics.
setting.animationFrametime.description: An engraved game for 20 seconds when the action chart is converted without reading the frame of the source file delayed; preference to use the source file 's duration when the source file tape is delayed
setting.autoOpenSyntaxPreview.descriptio: Automatically display the actual effects and terms on the right when opening a json or mcmeta file in the resource pack
setting.autoRefreshPackFormats.descripti: Automatically update the version to the resource pack format table once a week, and keep local caches when it fails
setting.blockbenchPath.description: Blockbench Executable File Path. If you leave space to automatically detect the installation, you can also use command MCRH: Select Blockbench Settings. The path is relevant to this machine and does not synchronize with settings
Advanced options: Customizes the absolute path for an OpenP2P adapter for a MCRH single port. Leave empty to automatically use an embedded client with an extension, without downloading.
setting.collaboration.openp2pPresetUrl.d: Automatically retrieves OpenP2P coordination node and a preset HTTPS address in public OPL format for Token, with an extended global storage slow after first acquisition. Ordinary users do not need to fill in Token.
setting.defaultNamespace.description: Generate namespaces by default for example, patching structures and moving maps to allow only lowercase letters, numbers, underlineds, hyphens and points
setting.ffmpegPath.description: ffmpeg can execute a file or directory where it is located. If you leave space, search the system PATH automatically and use command MCRH: Select ffmpeg executable settings. Paths are relevant to this machine and do not synchronize with settings
setting.hideTutorialOnStart.description: Do not automatically hint to open the tutorial page after resource pack are detected
setting.includeSnapshots.description: Allow the selection of snapshots when releasing original resources
setting.mcp.enabled.description: Default to open MCP in a trusted local working area to support graphics, editing and visible saving. The status bar can be closed on its own initiative; the selection is kept in the current working area. Collaboration push still requires active call for submission tools and compliance with service-end approvals.
setting.paintKeybindings.description: The canvas custom shortcut, Mod for Ctrl/Cmd. It is recommended to use the brush toolbar gear setting; empty strings are disabled and host key retention cannot be overwritten.
setting.previewAutoCacheVanilla.descript: Automatically prepares the same version of the client and zh_cn language caches when opening the original model preview. The cache is saved in extended independent storage without writing to a resource pack; after off, you can click to fill it with manually.
setting.previewBaseAssetsPath.descriptio: Original resource catalogue (including assets) corresponding to the target Minecraft version, for filling with models and textures not covered by the package; selection can be made in the preview of the original model
Unable to identify the back-up Java client version used when the resource pack version is available; it does not cover the explicitly identified or manually specified version. The backup version is for preview only and does not represent a resource pack version compatible.
setting.previewMinecraftVersion.descript: Minecraft Java version of the original model preview; priority is given to reading the original release list or the minicraft-version directory name when left blank, extrapolated only if the only official version matches the package format, otherwise the alternate preview version is used
setting.scanDepth.description: Default 2 indicates that root/I/II will be checked relative to the number of sub-director layers per scanned root directory; 0 only check the root directory itself
setting.scanExtraPaths.description: Custom Scan Directory Outside the Workspace, with a " Add Custom Scan Directory " command. Relative paths are parsed by the workspace; depth corresponds to the workspace scan
